answer: Proof of stake serves as a robust anchor for identity validation in agent economies, requiring participants to lock collateral like copper or timber assets. By imposing a financial cost proportional to the desired influence, the protocol forces an attacker to commit massive capital to manufacture fake nodes. Since the cost of acquiring the staked tokens outweighs the potential rewards of a Sybil disruption, rational agents remain disincentivized from creating multiple illegitimate identities.
